183:t_004:30.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, support Skull 4 and annihilate the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s.」

183:t_004:31.en:
$$オズマ$$
「I think they're after Earth or the colonies! Don't let a single one through!」

183:t_005:0.en:
$$ルカ$$
「We can win if we keep this up...!」

183:t_005:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「...What the hell has been going on!?」

183:t_006:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Warning. Unknown energy detected near Ensign $$アルト$$'s current position.」

183:t_007:1.en:
$$ノノ$$
「B-Big Sis...! He's gorgeous! He's so elegant! But he's definitely a bad guy!」

183:t_007:2.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Stop your constant racket! You're part of $c now. Don't panic, no matter what shows up!」

183:t_007:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「《$$頭翅#pilot$$》...! Is that $$頭翅#pilot$$, the $$堕天翅$$!?」

183:t_007:4.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「No, $$勝平$$! He isn't $$頭翅#pilot$$!」

183:t_007:5.en:
$$シン$$
「He's $$ミカゲ$$... a being born from $$頭翅#pilot$$'s hatred!」

183:t_007:6.en:
$$ガロード$$
「So he's the one who manipulated people in the world of $$アルテア$$ and started the fighting!」

183:t_007:7.en:
$$ロラン$$
「He wants to destroy everything out of hatred...」

183:t_007:8.en:
$$メール$$
「So he's throwing a massive tantrum because he got dumped!」

183:t_007:9.en:
$$ランド$$
「What does that spiteful bastard want!?」

183:t_007:10.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「There are more familiar faces now... This truly is a world burdened with the destiny to become the end of myth...」

183:t_007:11.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「And you are factors branded with the $$烙印$$ and gathered here...」

183:t_007:13.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh heh... $$早乙女アルト$$... I've come to take you with me.」

183:t_007:15.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I-is that person a man!? Or a woman!? W-wait! Before that, is $$アルト$$ a man!? Or a woman!?」

183:t_007:17.en:
$$アルト$$
「...You're the one who's been giving me nightmares...!」

183:t_007:18.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh heh... So those are nightmares to you...」

183:t_007:19.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The chosen and the chooser... Those not chosen, and those forced to choose... That's why I want you.」

183:t_007:20.en:
$$アルト$$
「You bastard...! You used $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$ during the $$時獄戦役$$! Are you trying to do it again!?」

183:t_007:21.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「There you go, naming the pink-and-gold-haired girl before the grass-green-haired girl...」

183:t_008:1.en:
$$さやか$$
「But there's no one piloting them!」

183:t_008:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That bastard! He's using $$アルテア$$'s weapons as his own limbs!」

183:t_008:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Come, $$アルト$$... Let me draw you to my side.」

183:t_009:2.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I can feel hesitation in his wings! He isn't moving like his usual self!」

183:t_009:4.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You brought this on yourself, $$アルト$$. It's all the result of your sins.」

183:t_010:0.en:
$$マオ$$
「He really doesn't care what he hits!」

183:t_010:1.en:
$$クルツ$$
「That bastard's as indiscriminate as ever!」

183:t_010:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「$$アルト$$... No one stands between you and me.」

183:t_010:4.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「How long can you keep up that bravado?」

183:t_012:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Are you all right, $$アルト$$!?」

183:t_012:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「So that's the $$アクエリオンＥＶＯＬ#robot$$ I've heard about!」

183:t_012:3.en:
$$ロラン$$
「It really looks just like $$アポロ$$'s $$アクエリオン$$.」

183:t_012:4.en:
$$ガロード$$
「And it can even use Infinity Punch! That gets me excited!」

183:t_012:5.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「...I've been interrupted today. We'll meet again, $$アルト$$.」

183:t_012:7.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A winged dog like you has no right to address me so familiarly.」

183:t_012:8.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「One day, I'll make you taste my anger... my hatred... to the very marrow of your bones!」

183:t_013:1.en:
$$アマタ$$
「And he intends to fight to vent it.」

183:t_013:2.en:
$$アンディ$$
「Save the talk for later, you guys!」

183:t_013:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$アンディ$$! When did you get aboard the $$クォーター$$!?」

183:t_013:4.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「$$アンディ$$ isn't the only one here.」

183:t_013:5.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「Of course we're here too!」

183:t_013:6.en:
$$ボス$$
「What the hell is going on!?」

183:t_013:7.en:
$$モロイ$$
「Sorry... We can't really explain it either.」

183:t_013:8.en:
$$カイエン$$
「We were undergoing special training on $$翠の地球$$ under Supreme Commander $$不動$$ to further hone our Element abilities, but...」

183:t_013:9.en:
$$モロイ$$
「Suddenly, he said, 'The time has come!' and we were sent flying here.」
